summary: Built and requested execution of the recovery-authority probe for the ballot question. The new test reuses the in-process harness and drives: a conflicting premise at replica 1, owner replica 0 proposing X on instance (0,0) and entering the Accept phase at ballot 0 (replies left in flight), then replica 2 recovering the same instance at its own ballot 7 so the answering peers record bal 7, then two ordinary owner-side startRecoveryForInstance attempts, then a third attempt after the target's own BeTheLeader handler runs. Local native feedback shows the predicted discrimination: both non-leader attempts emit Try ballot 0 against peers storing 7 (prepare_ballot_above_stored_bal false, appended_replies 1 of a slow quorum of 3, no sub-case dispatched and no follow-up message), while the post-BeTheLeader attempt uses ballot 10, appends three matching replies, dispatches the accept phase and completes the instance with X committed at replicas 0, 1, 3 and 4. Declaration anchors, prerequisite chains and four comparisons (two expected violated, two control comparisons expected to hold) are declared; the controller's receipt is still outstanding, so the question's interpretation remains to be written once it lands.
